title: A Primer of the Steady Breath
summary: A first course in drawing and holding qi through the breath so that air answers the student before any technique is tried.

title: The Wind Cultivator's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book for the first season of wind work that trains the gust and the turned wrist in a fixed order of practice.

title: Handbook of Drawn Air
summary: A handbook on pulling air toward the body and letting it go so that a student learns the draw before the strike.

title: The Gust and Step Workbook
summary: A workbook that pairs short bursts of air with light footwork so the student learns to move and push in one rhythm.

title: A Short Primer on Reading the Air
summary: A short primer that teaches the student to feel the movement of air about the body and to answer it with small guards.

title: The Breath Spiral Handbook
summary: A handbook of coiling motions that wind qi into a spiral through the chest and release it from the palm or the foot.

title: Workbook of the Light Draft
summary: A workbook on making the body light with a cushion of moving air and striking from that lightness without losing balance.

title: The Open Palm Wind Primer
summary: A primer on using the flat of the hand to throw guard and push air so that the student fights with a single clean motion.

title: A Handbook of Turning Currents
summary: A handbook on catching the flow of air and turning it to push or guard or carry the student along its path.

title: The Common Book of Breeze Work
summary: A common book gathering the plain breeze exercises every wind student meets from touch and wrap to sweep and quiet listening.
